steps.expected: SOV ring with no enlarged slice and no centre value; rankings with no highlighted row

results.notes: Data adapted: UA = "Electric bikes" (42c3ab89, UNBRANDED, COMPLETED, single collection of 20 Oct 2026): 1 market United Kingdom - English, C1 = "Commuter Electric Bikes" (2 Visibility + 2 Category Topics prompts) + automatic "Other" category (1 custom Other-type prompt "Which electric bike brands are best for commuting in London?"), engines ChatGPT + Gemini, no Competitive prompt. Side observations (known findings, seen again here): the SOV legend rounds 22.5 to 23% and 7.5 to 8%, so the percentages add up to 102%; the topics list keeps aria-label "Perception topics".

results.title: Brand Prioritization plots the top 5 brands by SOV with no target dot

steps.title: Given the user opens category C1 of analysis UA with market filter GB (EN)
steps.expected: Brand Prioritization is displayed
steps.observed: Category C1 opened with the only market, United Kingdom (static market label, no market selector); Brand Prioritization displayed ("5 brands").

steps.title: When the matrix loads
steps.expected: Quadrants Stars, Opportunity, At Risk and Monitor are shown
steps.observed: Quadrants Stars (0), Opportunity (0), At Risk (5) and Monitor (0) are shown.

steps.title: Then it plots the 5 brands with the highest SOV
steps.data: Compare with the SOV ring of C1, GB (EN)
steps.expected: Exactly the top 5 brands of the SOV ring are plotted
steps.observed: Plotted (cluster expanded): Specialized, Ribble, Tern, Carrera, MiRider (brand-matrix API: same 5 points). SOV ring order: Specialized 23%, Carrera 10%, Ribble 10%, Tern 10%, Cannondale 8%, MiRider 8%. Raw SOV: Cannondale 7.5 and MiRider 7.5 tie for 5th place; the matrix keeps MiRider, the ring lists Cannondale 5th. 4 of the 5 ring brands match; the 5th is a tie with no defined tie-break.

steps.title: And there is no target dot
steps.expected: No dot is styled as target and no label reads "(Target)"
steps.observed: No target dot: every point isTargetBrand=false, all dots share the same style (market flag + label), no "(Target)" label.

results.notes: Data adapted: UA = "Electric bikes" (42c3ab89, UNBRANDED, COMPLETED, single collection of 20 Oct 2026): 1 market United Kingdom - English, C1 = "Commuter Electric Bikes" (2 Visibility + 2 Category Topics prompts) + automatic "Other" category (1 custom Other-type prompt "Which electric bike brands are best for commuting in London?"), engines ChatGPT + Gemini, no Competitive prompt. Topic "Electric bikes" instead of "Postal services"; no C2, no FR market. PARTIAL because "Exactly the top 5 brands of the SOV ring" cannot be decided: 5th place is a tie at 7.5% and the ring (Cannondale) and the matrix / landscape (MiRider) break it differently. PO question: which tie-break applies to the top 5 (and should the ring and matrix use the same one)? Side findings: (1) the UI puts the 5 brands in "At Risk" while the brand-matrix API returns quadrant "MONITOR" for all 5 (quadrantCounts monitor=5); (2) the expanded cluster spills outside the plot area (Tern below the 0% axis, Ribble clipped at the right edge).
